comments.body:
## Fixed — commit `c996c9394ac`, pending Gerrit

**Reproduction proof.** The new case `test_packed_drop_route_survives_a_blob_git_already_packed` packs the blob and deletes the loose copy before the route runs. Against the pre-fix helper (grafted onto `git show HEAD:tests/unit/test_pinned_ticket_view.py`) it fails with exactly CI's assertion:

```
>       assert loose.is_file(), f"expected {blob_oid} to be loose; got {loose}"
E       AssertionError: expected 6311abeb... to be loose
```

With the fix it passes, as do both original parametrizations.

**One approach refuted before it was built on.** The first design was to *establish* looseness with `git cat-file blob <oid> | git hash-object -w -t blob --stdin`, so neither route would assert a representation. Measured it on a throwaway repo: git **skips the write** when the object already exists in a pack, so no loose copy appears. `hash-object -w` cannot rematerialize a packed object, and the design was dropped rather than assumed.

**A probe of mine was also wrong, and is recorded so it is not repeated.** An early measurement reported "blob is neither loose nor packed, 0 packs". That was a probe bug: the tracker is a **linked worktree**, so its objects live in the parent repo's shared `.git/objects`, and the literal path `<tracker>/.git/objects` does not exist. `_object_root` already resolves this correctly via `git rev-parse --git-path objects`. Re-probed properly: the blob **is** loose under `_freeze_gc`.

**What changed.**

- Neither route asserts looseness any more. Both end at `_assert_blob_unreadable`, which checks the condition the test actually depends on and names the pre-existing-pack case when it is not reached.
- `_drop_packed` removes the blob from **every** pack holding it, rebuilding each containing pack without it first, so commits and trees that shared a pack stay readable. That is what makes the already-packed shape survivable rather than merely tolerated.
- A missing loose copy in the packed route is read as that route's own premise, not a setup failure.

**Not pursued, deliberately.** Which packer removed the loose copy in CI remains unattributed. Two hypotheses were already refuted by measurement (recorded in the description), so per Three Strikes I stopped hypothesising and fixed the defect that is readable in the tree instead. The fix holds whichever packer ran, because the route no longer depends on the answer.

## Symptom

`tests/unit/test_pinned_ticket_view.py::test_tree_listed_ticket_blob_missing_from_object_database_fails_closed[packed-_drop_packed]`
failed the GATING cell (`pytest (ubuntu-latest, py3.13)`) of GitHub Actions run
[35517603759](https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/actions/runs/35517603759), casting a spurious
`Verified -1` on Gerrit change 3008 (ticket `2277-7043-1f63-4f5c`), whose diff streams Jira
DC harness test progress and touches nothing on this test's path.

```
tests/unit/test_pinned_ticket_view.py:695:
tests/unit/test_pinned_ticket_view.py:668: in _drop_packed
tests/unit/test_pinned_ticket_view.py:653: in _drop_loose
>       assert loose.is_file(), f"expected {blob_oid} to be loose; got {loose}"
E       AssertionError: expected fb9d1b4935c7f78e7d91558bed4bd8445b88da3a to be loose
E       assert False

1 failed, 20479 passed, 82 skipped in 1568.74s
```

The sibling `[loose-_drop_loose]` parametrization passed in the same run.

## Root cause — an implementation that contradicts its own ticket's Definition of Done

This is not a new race. It is `7bcc-55a9-7a28-412d` incompletely fixed, and the gap is
readable in the tree rather than inferred.

`7bcc` existed precisely to remove this dependency. Its AC1 is *"The test no longer depends
on the blob being LOOSE"* and its Definition of Done is *"The test cannot fail on its own
setup precondition."* The packed route it added then reintroduced the precondition it was
written to delete, by reusing the loose route's helper:

```python
def _drop_packed(tracker, object_root, blob_oid):
    ...
    prefix = _git(tracker, "pack-objects", str(pack_dir / "pack"), stdin=f"{blob_oid}\n")
    assert prefix, "git pack-objects wrote no pack"
    _drop_loose(tracker, object_root, blob_oid)   # <-- asserts loose.is_file()
```

`_drop_loose` opens with `assert loose.is_file()`. So the packed route — the one whose whole
purpose is to cover the case where git has packed the object — still fails outright when git
has packed the object. The one shape it exists to handle is the one shape it cannot survive.

Removing the loose copy is incidental to that route's intent. What the route actually needs
is that the blob ends up unreadable, and it already proves the interesting half of that with
`git cat-file -e` after the pack is written. Asserting *how* git stored the object is
asserting a representation git has never guaranteed — which is the exact defect `7bcc`
diagnosed.

## Why the earlier fixes did not close it

`3ce7-0c9d-d9e5-437b` fixed a real and different thing: `rebar init` left detached
`git maintenance --detach` children that repacked the shared object DB outside rebar's write
lock. That removed one packer and so made this failure rarer, which is why it has been quiet.
It could not eliminate the failure, because any packer at all still trips an assertion that
demands looseness.

Verified that the `3ce7` fix is present and holding at `641531e62e5`:

- `_gc_config_unit(repo)` is called at the top of `_mount_or_create_branch`
  (`src/rebar/_commands/init.py:292`), before the store's first commit.
- Replaying the fixture sequence (`init_repo` -> raw `git commit --allow-empty` ->
  `create_ticket`) under `GIT_TRACE2_EVENT` on git 2.55 and counting with
  `tests/_git_upkeep.maintenance_children()`: **7 maintenance children, 0 detached.**

So the detach hole is closed and this failure is a separate, still-open defect.

## Investigation already done — two hypotheses refuted by measurement

Recorded so the next person does not repeat them.

1. **"The ensure sweep unsets `gc.auto`, defeating the test's `_freeze_gc`."** Plausible
   because `_gc_config_unit` deliberately does `--unset gc.auto`. **Refuted:** probed a live
   store — after `_freeze_gc` set `gc.auto=0` / `maintenance.auto=false`, a subsequent
   `rebar.create_ticket` left both values exactly as frozen.
2. **"Something after `rebar init` still spawns a detached maintenance child."** **Refuted**
   by the trace2 count above: 0 detached.

Local reproduction attempts, for the record: 60/60 passes serially on this host (git 2.55).
The failure needs CI's parallel xdist load to surface, which is consistent with a
storage-shape race rather than a deterministic bug — and consistent with `7bcc`'s own note
that it reproduced on CI and not locally.

## Approach

Stop asserting the storage representation; assert the condition the test actually depends on.

In the packed route, unlink the loose copy **only if it exists** — its absence means git
already packed the blob, which is that route's own premise, not a setup failure. Then verify
the achieved end state (the blob is no longer readable) rather than the path taken to reach
it, so a blob that survives in a pre-existing pack is reported as an explicit, legible setup
failure instead of a confusing downstream mismatch.

The loose route keeps its assertion: there, looseness is the shape under test, and if the
object is not loose that case genuinely cannot run.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The packed route does not fail when the target blob is already packed. Verified by a test that packs the blob before the route runs and shows the route still completes.
- [ ] The packed route still leaves commits and trees readable. Verified by asserting the raised error names the ticket's own `*-CREATE.json` path, not the generic missing-object phrase.
- [ ] After setup, the target blob is unreadable, and a blob left readable by a pre-existing pack fails with a message naming that condition. Verified by asserting on the setup's end state.
- [ ] The behaviour under test still runs in both parametrizations: the pinned view fails closed on a missing object.
- [ ] No route asserts git's storage representation as a preconditionl — `7bcc`'s Definition of Done actually holds. Verified by reading both routes.
- [ ] The fix requires no single CI provider. Verified by reading the changed code for any GitHub Actions or Gerrit dependency.

## Verification

```
pytest tests/unit/test_pinned_ticket_view.py::test_tree_listed_ticket_blob_missing_from_object_database_fails_closed -p no:randomly
```

green in both parametrizations, plus a new case that pre-packs the blob and fails against
today's `_drop_packed`.
compiled_state.title: Pinned-view packed route still asserts the loose precondition 7bcc removed, so it fails on the one shape it exists to cover
